semiconductor_relevance: High — Stasys Korea specializes in static control systems, which are critical for managing electrostatic discharge (ESD) in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Stasys Korea Co., Ltd. is an official agent for Ion Systems in Korea, providing technical services and solutions for electrostatic control in semiconductor manufacturing. The company focuses on reducing costs and improving operational quality through innovative ESD solutions tailored to customer needs.

regional_presence.Korea: Stasys Korea operates a service center in Bucheon city, providing local support and technical services.
